subject: Second-order proximity
object: Nodes with shared neighbors being likely to be similar
evidence_quote: The general notion of the second-order proximity can be interpreted as nodes with shared neighbors being likely to be similar.

subject: People who share many common friends
evidence_quote: Indeed, people who share many common friends are likely to share the same interest and become friends, and words that are used together with many similar words are likely to have similar meanings.
